name: Remote-Desktop
description: A general-purpose remote desktop workstation container: Ubuntu with the GNOME desktop, accessible from any RDP client via GNOME Remote Desktop headless remote login. GPU passthrough (VAAPI) is configured automatically and /dev/kvm can be passed through as an opt-in, making it suitable for development environments (IDEs, Android Emulator) and other desktop workloads.

notes.text: Connect with any RDP client (e.g. Remmina, Windows App) to port 3389 and log in with the desktop user created during installation.
The desktop user is a sudoer. Install your applications (IDEs, browsers, etc.) directly inside the remote session.

GPU passthrough requires the GPU to be bound to host drivers (not vfio-pci). /dev/kvm passthrough (opt-in during install, or var_kvm=yes) enables hardware-accelerated virtualization, e.g. for the Android Emulator.
No browser is preinstalled: Ubuntu's Firefox is snap-based and cannot be installed during container build. Install a browser inside the session, e.g. via snap, Flatpak or vendor deb.
